description: Source code implementing ubus support for wpa_supplicant, including functions for managing ubus connections, handling events, and WPS credential notifications.

methods.name: get_wpas_from_object
methods.description: Retrieves the wpa_supplicant structure from a ubus object.

methods.name: ubus_reconnect_timeout
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect ubus after a timeout.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_ref_dec
methods.description: Decrements ubus context reference count and frees if zero.

methods.name: wpas_bss_get_features
methods.description: Retrieves features of the BSS via ubus.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a BSS object to ubus.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS object from ubus.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_notify
methods.description: Sends WPS credential notification event via ubus.
